name: Korean peninsula
value: Missile salvo 4 Nov; 4th launch in a month
summary: North Korea fired several missiles on 4 Nov, its fourth launch in a month
state: North Korea fired several missiles toward the Sea of Japan on 4 Nov, its fourth weapons launch in a month, South Korea's military said (US News; Japan Times). State media said an earlier weekend launch tested a new dispersion warhead. No nuclear test or ICBM overflight of Japan had been reported as of 6 Nov.
for_you: No direct effect outside the region; Japan and South Korea issue alerts to residents if a launch threatens their territory.
rubric_hit: Ballistic missile launches = Watch; no nuclear test or overflight
